verdicts.reason: Both break the original's parallel two-couplet structure: the first 'PRAY' is shoved to the right of 'When Life Is Rough' at a small size while the second 'PRAY' is huge, so the two halves no longer match. The divider is now a vertical rule running beside the 'Great' text instead of separating the two couplets, and the copy sizes are inconsistent. A is marginally better because 'When Life Is Great' sits close to its 'PRAY'. In B, 'Great' floats mid-line with a dead gap above the bottom 'PRAY', which splits that pair apart.
